# m.partners.benzinga.analysts

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Benzinga's profiles of sell-side analysts, with each analyst's firm and track record.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.analysts(*, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Analyst Details (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings | Updated every 2 hours |
| Benzinga Analyst Insights | Updated every 2 hours |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings Business | Updated every 2 hours |
| Benzinga Analyst Insights Business | Updated every 2 hours |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The unique identifier assigned by Benzinga to the research firm or investment bank. |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. |
| `FirmName` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the ratings. |
| `FullName` | String | The full name of the analyst associated with the ratings. |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the analyst record was last updated in the system. |
| `OverallAvgReturn` | double | The average percent price difference per rating since the date of recommendation. |
| `OverallAvgReturnPercentile` | double | The analyst's percentile rank based on average return, relative to other analysts. |
| `OverallSuccessRate` | double | The percentage of gain/loss ratings that resulted in a gain overall. |
| `SmartScore` | double | A weighted average of the total_ratings_percentile, overall_avg_return_percentile, and overall_success_rate. |
| `TotalRatings` | double | The total number of ratings issued by the analyst included in the performance calculation. |
| `TotalRatingsPercentile` | double | The analyst's percentile rank based on the total number of ratings issued, relative to other analysts. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
